title: Test track
intro: Call a simulated provider with a test key, choose what should go wrong, then read the request, the response and every webhook. No merchant account, no real money.

visitor.heading: A test key is waiting for you
visitor.body: Sign in to create a key, call the simulator from your code and receive the webhooks on your machine.
visitor.demo: Try the demo without an account

provider.heading: Provider
provider.label: Simulated provider
provider.choices: What the simulator decides where the documentation is silent
provider.unavailable: This provider has no simulator yet. Here are the ones that do.

success.label: Payment succeeds
success.help: The success webhook, delivered at once.

insufficient_funds.label: Insufficient funds
insufficient_funds.help: The payment fails, the failure webhook leaves at once.

timeout.label: Provider timeout
timeout.help: The payer does not answer in time: see what the provider returns.

duplicate_webhook.label: Duplicate webhook
duplicate_webhook.help: The same event, twice, 5 s apart.

late_webhook.label: Late webhook
late_webhook.help: The webhook leaves 60 s after the payment.

keys.heading: Test key
keys.empty: A key identifies your calls and your webhooks. It expires after 30 days.
keys.revealBody: Overpass keeps only a digest of it: it will never be shown again.
keys.meta: Expires on {{date}}, quota of {{quota}} calls a day
keys.revokeBody: Calls and relays using it are refused at once. Its history stays visible for 7 days.
keys.secretHelp: Check the webhook signature with this secret, as you would with the provider's.

target.heading: Where webhooks go

inbox.label: Built-in receiver
inbox.help: Read every webhook here, nothing to install.

relay.label: Local relay on my machine
relay.help: For your development server: no public URL, no tunnel.

url.label: My public URL
url.help: A private or local address is refused.

target.terminal: Terminal, your key is already in
target.terminalPrefix: Terminal: replace the key prefix with your full key
target.relayHelp: The command opens an outgoing connection to Overpass and replays each webhook on your server, body and headers untouched.
target.urlHelp: Overpass checks it again before each delivery and follows no redirect.
target.inboxHelp: Webhooks show under Deliveries, with their body and headers.

launch.heading: Launch
launch.note: {{method}} {{path}}, the documentation's example, with your test key.
launch.needKey: Create a test key first: the simulated payment uses it.

inspector.heading: Inspector
inspector.label: Content of the call
inspector.emptyBody: Run a simulated payment, or call the simulator from your code with this key.

deliveries.heading: Deliveries
deliveries.caption: Body and headers as your server receives them

deliveries.replayed: Delivery replayed: it leaves in a moment.
deliveries.same: Same id as the previous delivery: your code should ignore it.

demo.title: Test track demo
demo.intro: A simulated Wave payment, no account needed: pick a scenario, run it, and watch the webhook arrive.
demo.waiting: The webhook is on its way.
demo.more: For your own calls and the local relay, create a test key.
demo.failed: The demo could not start. Try again in a moment.

launchPage.title: Simulated payment
launchPage.body: This page stands in for the {{provider}} payment page during your tests. Your key's scenario decides the outcome: there is nothing to pay here.
